answer: The glacier is the live check: a new identity must speak a random phrase on camera, on a phone whose hardware attestation key is registered once and bound to that account. The juniper is the cooldown: one key can register only one identity every thirty days, so a second account needs a second real device. The vault is the cost to a farm: faking a hundred identities means buying a hundred phones and passing a hundred live checks, while an honest person registers once and never repeats it.
